quests.desc: It's time to explore the amazing world of TextWorld! Here is your task for today. First of all, go west. With that done, open the writing desk inside the Library. And then, pick up the brass key from the writing desk in the Library. With the brass key, venture east. With that done, unlock the carved oak door. If you have unlocked the carved oak door, ensure that the carved oak door is open. After that, go north. Then, move east. With that done, make absolutely sure that the glass cabinet within the Astronomer's Study is wide open. And then, retrieve the silver key from the glass cabinet in the Astronomer's Study. Then, head west. If you can get through with that, make an effort to head south. And then, unlock the iron workshop door within the Great Hall. Then, open the iron workshop door. Then, head east. Then, take the small iron key from the heavy workbench inside the Clockwork Workshop. After that, try to take a trip south. After that, doublecheck that the black strongbox in the Wine Cellar is unlocked with the small iron key. After unlocking the black strongbox, ensure that the black strongbox is open. After that, retrieve the heavy vault key from the black strongbox inside the Wine Cellar. After that, make sure that the steel vault door is unlocked with the heavy vault key. And then, assure that the steel vault door is ajar. After that, travel east. That done, open the stone coffer. And then, retrieve the sunstone from the stone coffer. Having picked up the sunstone, try to go to the west. That done, head north. That done, make an attempt to travel west. And then, you can put the sunstone into the ceremonial plinth inside the Great Hall. Got that? Good!

infos.name: Great Hall
infos.desc: A vaulted hall watched by dusty portraits. A ceremonial plinth stands beneath a cracked glass dome.

infos.name: Library
infos.desc: Tall shelves lean beneath the weight of forgotten books. A writing desk sits in an alcove under the western window.

infos.name: Astronomer's Study
infos.desc: Star charts cover the walls. A glass cabinet glitters beside a brass telescope aimed at the ceiling.

infos.name: launderette
infos.desc: Generations of stern manor residents stare from tarnished frames. A narrow passage continues toward the east wing.

infos.name: Clockwork Workshop
infos.desc: Silent gears and unfinished mechanisms crowd every surface. A heavy workbench dominates the room.

infos.name: Hidden Vault
infos.desc: The air is cold and perfectly still. A carved stone coffer occupies the center of the chamber.

infos.name: Wine Cellar
infos.desc: Empty bottle racks line the damp stone walls. A strongbox rests between two collapsed barrels.

infos.name: Overgrown Courtyard
infos.desc: Moonlit ivy has swallowed the old fountain. The manor's tall windows look down on the weeds.

infos.name: carved oak door
infos.desc: The door bears a carving of a many-branched tree.

infos.name: iron workshop door
infos.desc: An iron door fitted with a delicate silver lock.

infos.name: steel vault door
infos.desc: A thick steel door with a deep, old-fashioned keyhole.

infos.name: ceremonial plinth
infos.desc: A shallow recess waits at its center.

infos.name: writing desk
infos.desc: Its single drawer is slightly crooked.

infos.name: glass cabinet
infos.desc: Dust clouds its glass doors.

infos.name: black strongbox
infos.desc: Its lid is reinforced with dark metal straps.

infos.name: stone coffer
infos.desc: Ancient symbols spiral around its lid.

infos.name: low bookshelf
infos.desc: A reachable shelf filled with brittle journals.

infos.name: brass telescope
infos.desc: Its lens points toward a painted constellation.

infos.name: heavy workbench
infos.desc: Tools lie scattered around a half-built clock.

infos.name: ivy-covered fountain
infos.desc: No water has flowed here for years.

infos.name: bottle rack
infos.desc: Only one dusty green bottle remains.

infos.name: brass key
infos.desc: A warm brass key shaped like a tree branch.

infos.name: silver key
infos.desc: A fine silver key engraved with a tiny gear.

infos.name: heavy vault key
infos.desc: A heavy key whose teeth resemble a skyline.

infos.name: sunstone
infos.desc: A golden crystal that seems to glow from within.

infos.name: small iron key
infos.desc: A plain key small enough for a box lock.

infos.name: faded journal
infos.desc: Most of its water-damaged pages are unreadable.

infos.name: rolled star chart
infos.desc: Several stars have been circled in red ink.

infos.name: copper gear
infos.desc: A loose gear from some unfinished mechanism.

infos.name: stone raven
infos.desc: A palm-sized carving with bright glass eyes.

infos.name: green bottle
infos.desc: The label has peeled away completely.

objective: The manor's sunstone was sealed away generations ago. Recover it from the hidden vault and return it to the ceremonial plinth in the Great Hall. Search carefully: the manor's locks form a chain, and each key brings you closer to the vault.
